question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance carrier be LANDED into the shipped kernel through the sanctioned promotion path -- so that, after promotion, the shipped execution path contains a concrete parameterized mechanism that an inherited procedure (distill_parameterized, inherited from the audited carrier) visibly instantiates and executes, together with a companion known-negative refusal certificate -- such that blocker B1 is satisfied and the pre-freeze executable mechanism required by readiness condition (1) exists, instead of once more running the four-arm economics benchmark on a kernel that still emits literals below the execution threshold (Director mandate question, request.json,director_mandate.allocation.question)?
hypothesis: Installing the audited parameterized-inheritance carrier kernel (research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/kernel.py, git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) BYTE-IDENTICALLY at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py -- with src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py already byte-identical to the carrier's versions (sha256 338aaf4d7ba0e31f7a5fe8a47abdbb2ea52d9c1c4ef0ce014f2b809b9a2a9b78 and 51fb440d3827f21cccb5f77ad17dc0e76ccdbc2d52d7b05044cd821bb8a9322c) and src/spider/__init__.py kept as the shipped public surface (sha256 3d173722b38c5130a5145b1558412a399f851c8ed4fbf2ddfa4022e4cb2b5a77) -- makes the shipped package: (a) satisfy readiness condition (1)/blocker B1: a concrete, parameterized mechanism (Mechanism with non-empty parameter_slots and verification_rule.parameter_supports, confidence 0.9 >= min_confidence 0.8) is VISIBLY instantiated by the inherited procedure distill_parameterized from induction observations on the SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture and is EXECUTED by resolve() on never-observed held-out identifiers on all six families (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP: resolution EXECUTABLE, bound action non-null and correctly bound, deterministic fixture execute status 200, verify true); (b) produce the companion known-negative refusal certificate (AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP): the full declared negative set -- out-of-support (empty/whitespace/slash), missing-parameter, out-of-support pair, wrong-intent -- is refused 24/24 with status non-EXECUTABLE, bound_action null and a recorded non-empty reason, and the certificate is emitted as a raw sidecar artifact; (c) keep the inherited-path accounting honest (PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY: scripted-trajectory max relative error <= 0.01; real inherited-path increments exactly {retrieval_calls: 3, verification_calls: 2, repair_attempts: 1}; model_calls = 0 and model_tokens = 0 by construction -- no model is ever invoked); (d) keep the pre-existing regression suite green under the canonical discovery invocation with the EXECUTE-added shipping-path unit tests; (e) preserve the installed-kernel identity equal to the frozen carrier hash (C1 identity binding), so the resulting src/ + tests/ delta is promotable by the pinned Product promotion workflow (.github/workflows/product-promote.yml) without manually copying experiment code into main. The literal-only baseline (pre-install shipped kernel, blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) has no distill_parameterized() and cannot satisfy the positive arm; the treatment is the audited parameterized path placed at the shipping position, which is exactly what blocker B1 requires.
falsifier: Any of: (1) C1 identity binding fails -- the installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 != 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 or git blob != b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, or any frozen artifact deviates from its freeze.json.artifact_hashes entry; (2) C2 positive roundtrip fails -- AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP does not pass 6/6 (no parameterized mechanism instantiated by distill_parameterized, resolution not EXECUTABLE, bound action null, bound identifier != expected held-out identifier, fixture execute status != 200, or verify != true on any family); (3) C3 known-negative sidecar fails -- any of the 24 declared negatives resolves EXECUTABLE, or has a non-null bound action, or has an empty reason, or the sidecar artifact is not written (per-category refusal rates < 1.0); (4) C4 treatment contrast fails -- AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST real contrast_rate == 0.0 on all families, or NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT degenerate variant is NOT detected (degenerate contrast_rate != 0.0); (5) C5 accounting fidelity fails -- scripted-trajectory max relative error > 0.01, or the real inherited-path increments are not exactly {retrieval_calls: 3, verification_calls: 2, repair_attempts: 1} (any nonzero model_calls/model_tokens is an automatic C5 failure and a governance error); (6) C6 literal control fails -- B-LITERAL-KERNEL held_out_executable_count > 0; (7) C7 promotability fails after a C1-passing byte-exact install -- the pre-existing tests/test_kernel.py or the EXECUTE-added shipping-path unit tests fail under the canonical discovery invocation, or `python -m compileall -q src scripts` returns nonzero. Any C2/C7 failure means the audited carrier, once installed at the shipping position, is not promotable in its audited form.

baselines.description: Literal-only kernel ablation (pre-repair semantics, preserved unchanged inside the carrier): SpiderKernel.distill() creates literal mechanisms at confidence 0.5 (< min_confidence 0.8) with no parameter_slots; on the parameterized held-out tasks this must produce 0 EXECUTABLE (UNKNOWN/EXPLORE). This isolates the contribution of the parameterized distill_parameterized path and is exactly the behavior of the current shipped kernel (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50). It is the FLOOR of the measurement's dynamic range: expected held_out_executable_count == 0, demonstrating genuine headroom between the literal state (floor) and the parameterized treatment (ceiling 6/6) so the two states are distinguishable (mandate agent prior (3): no ceiling-vs-ceiling ambiguity).

Retrieval-shaped comparator: the literal action of the K=5 structurally nearest induction observation (Jaccard over flattened intent/state/action key paths, from the frozen fixture reconstruction), executed with no parameter binding and no support re-check. Used only inside AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST to show the treatment's re-bound parameterized action differs from the retrieved literal action (contrast on at least one family). Non-gating for the promotion decision.

Baseline identity of the shipping kernel BEFORE install: src/spider/kernel.py git blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61 (literal-only: no distill_parameterized, no rebind, no TrajectoryCounters). Recorded so the identity change is unambiguous, so baseline_identifiability is provable, and so a negative outcome can revert the Product branch to this exact state (revert_product_reject.py).

positive_control.description: Known-positive arm-differentiation control demonstrating B1/readiness-condition (1) concretely: for each of the six SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 families, the inherited procedure distill_parameterized() induces one parameterized Mechanism from the four induction observations (inherited observations), reg.upsert() it, resolve() is called on the stable context with the held-out identifier keyed by the mechanism's OWN inferred slot names, the bound action is executed against the deterministic fixture (status 200), and verify() confirms the templated postconditions. Slot-name re-keying: held-out values are taken from the family held_out dict (keyed by family slot_keys) and re-keyed onto the mechanism's inferred slot names (e.g. F2-QUERY-ID infers slot 'q' from leaf 'params.q'); among all permutations of slots -> held_out values, EXACTLY ONE may resolve EXECUTABLE with the correctly bound identifier (uniqueness guard -- an over-accepting kernel produces >1 executable permutation and fails). This convention was established by the pre-freeze probe (prereg.md section 7) and is part of the frozen measurement.
positive_control.expected_behavior: 6/6 families: one parameterized Mechanism instantiated (confidence 0.9, non-empty parameter_slots, non-empty verification_rule.parameter_supports, no noise-field slots), exactly one executable permutation, resolution EXECUTABLE, bound_action non-null, bound identifier == the expected held-out identifier for that family, fixture execute status == 200, verify == true; in_support_executable_rate == 1.0 and held_out_binding_correct_rate == 1.0.

null_control.description: Degenerate zero-contrast null. The SAME contrast instrument used for AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST is run with the comparator action on BOTH sides (comparator-vs-itself). A naive/insensitive contrast instrument would still report a pass; a sensitive one reports degenerate contrast_rate == 0.0 and flags the degenerate variant.
null_control.expected_behavior: degenerate_variant contrast_rate == 0.0 and degenerate_variant_detected == true (the zero-contrast degenerate arm must FAIL the contrast check).

measurement_validity: Credential-free, deterministic, standard-library-only: the certificate, fixture and accounting path use no model, no browser, no network and no database. Verified environment: Python 3.12.15, git 2.55.0 (probe run 2026-10-11). model_calls = 0 and model_tokens = 0 by construction; any nonzero value is a governance error (C5 fails).

DETERMINISM DISCLOSURE (not a causal-discovery experiment): the confirmatory measurement is deterministic because the installed bytes are PINNED to the frozen audited carrier hash. DESIGN therefore already executed the arm-differentiation certificate as the mandatory v2 treatment-liveness satisfiability probe against a byte-faithful sandbox replica of the REAL shipping tree (real src/spider/__init__.py, models.py, registry.py and the carrier kernel at the kernel position). The probe driver source (probe_exp_38101226651.py, sha256 a7f42ec4e87089b10bd18d2e1492e1dd2ca3dc8194ff68608ec665855e2f608e), the reproduction commands and all observed values are embedded in prereg.md section 7 (PROBE_SUMMARY). EXECUTE re-runs the identical certificate against the ACTUAL installed src/spider package as the confirmatory measurement; a deviation between the probe expectation and the EXECUTE observation is a measurement-invalidity signal (or BLOCKED if the file cannot be installed), never a silent pass. Downstream agents must not mistake this deterministic engineering confirmation for new causal evidence about web behavior; the claim-level ceiling remains that recorded by the two audit-PASS packets (EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 arm-differentiation certificate, EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 live path) and by this packet's parent (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 bounded substrate-class negative).

Identity binding (gate): the installed src/spider/kernel.py must equal the frozen carrier artifact byte-for-byte: sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796. The carrier's models.py (338aaf4d...) and registry.py (51fb440d...) are already byte-identical to the shipped src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py (same blobs f08608c3... and 986317f7...), so the only production module that changes is the kernel. The carrier package __init__.py is EMPTY and is NOT used at install; the shipped __init__.py (3d173722...) is bound and stays the package surface. TrajectoryCounters is importable from spider.kernel (module scope); adding a package-level re-export is explicitly out of scope.

Freeze artifacts are immutable interpretation dependencies for this transaction: carrier kernel/models/registry (treatment source AND required installed-identity target for the kernel), the SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture reconstruction (research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128/harness/fixture.py, sha256 b0ffcbba5041871f58408c4766268b31bb84cb81ccef965cd944c486fd4dd6cf), the shipped import dependencies src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py, the shipped public surface src/spider/__init__.py (deliberately kept byte-identical), and the pre-existing regression suite tests/test_kernel.py (sha256 ff9c1561c4169d306fba56d52442546a3bbfdab11d3ab56c51d7369309e9c0b6). EXECUTE must not modify them. src/spider/kernel.py is deliberately NOT a freeze artifact because EXECUTE replaces its content; its post-install identity is pinned by decision_rule C1 and its pre-install baseline is recorded as B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL. Freeze.v2 artifacts are real repository files hashed at freeze time into freeze.json.artifact_hashes (addressing the parent handoff's do_not_assume that freeze.json cannot hash code: the CARRIER is a repo file and IS hashed; only the install-target path is pinned by identity rule instead).

Known-negative sidecar certificate: out-of-support identifiers (empty, whitespace, slash, and the out-of-grammar slot pair), missing required parameters, and wrong intent are re-keyed through the same frozen slot mapping and every negative must yield a non-EXECUTABLE status (EXPLORE or UNKNOWN), bound_action == null, and a non-empty recorded reason; per-category refusal rates are reported and must all be 1.0. The certificate row set is emitted as a raw sidecar artifact (known_negatives.jsonl) so the 'known-negative refusal certificate' demanded by the Director mandate is durable evidence, not a summary claim. Disclosure inherited from the parent chain: wrong-intent refusals share the generic reason string 'no applicable validated mechanism' with the null-type control; the sidecar categorizes them by the harness mapping, and distinct intent-mismatch detection is therefore NOT independently demonstrated (the audit of EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 recorded the same caveat).

Accounting honesty (PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY): (a) a seeded 5-step scripted trajectory with a declared ground truth over all eight counters requires max relative error <= 0.01; (b) a real inherited-path exercise on family F1 (resolve-EXECUTABLE + verify + refused-resolve + rebind + verify) must increment retrieval_calls by exactly 3, verification_calls by exactly 2 and repair_attempts by exactly 1. The model_calls/model_tokens events in (a) are an explicitly injected labeled synthetic event; the experiment makes no model calls.

Equal tooling and no stochastic arm-to-arm comparison: the treatment, the literal ablation, the retrieval comparator and the degenerate null consume the same frozen fixture and the same kernel surface in one deterministic process (same Python, same git, same machine).

Canonical regression invocation: the repository runs tests as `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (see .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/product-promote.yml). The CPython unittest runner emits its protocol on stderr; certificate runners must capture both streams. tests/ has no __init__.py, so module-path invocation is not canonical. The DESIGN probe confirmed the pre-existing tests/test_kernel.py passes both pre-install (against the shipped tree) and post-install (against the sandbox replica) under the canonical invocation.

Promotion-path dependency (operational, recorded for downstream): .github/workflows/product-promote.yml promotes ONLY the delta over allowed_code_roots ([src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml]) between execution_checkpoint.json.pre_execute_sha (written automatically by scripts/record_execution_base.py before EXECUTE) and the commit that CREATED verdict.json, via `git apply --index --3way` onto current main, then runs `python -m compileall -q src scripts`, `python scripts/validate_repo.py` and the canonical unittest discovery before committing. EXECUTE must therefore keep the code-root delta minimal and exclusive: ONLY src/spider/kernel.py replaced and tests/test_ship_kernel.py added; nothing else under src/, tests/, sdk/ or pyproject.toml may change. If main has diverged in src/spider since the execution base, the 3-way apply can conflict and promotion hard-stops. This is an operational dependency, not a scientific falsifier.

The unit tests are NOT the decision instrument: the certificate (AD-* / PC-* / NC-* / B-LITERAL / AD-IDENTITY) is the decision instrument and its raw JSON is written by the certificate runner. The EXECUTE-added unit test module is a secondary regression surface; even if it were vacuous, C2-C6 would still gate the decision from the certificate JSON (which AUDIT recomputes from raw evidence).

No-residue rule: on FALSIFIES/MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED the Product branch tree must not keep the installed kernel; revert_product_reject.py reverts the code-root delta to pre_execute_sha (B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL, sha256 46929b3a...).

Satisfiability was certified pre-freeze on BOTH sides of dynamic range (mandate agent priors (2) and (3)): (i) treatment-liveness probe at the shipping position passed all certificate checks (prereg.md section 7 PROBE_SUMMARY); (ii) the not-installed state is detected (preinstall probe: shipped tree has no distill_parameterized, B-LITERAL 0 EXECUTABLE, identity 46929b3a != 718efa6a); (iii) any byte drift of the installed kernel is detected (drift probe: one-byte change => observed sha 42e3b667... != 718efa6a...). No branch is empty or unreachable.

decision_rule.C1_identity_binding: PASS iff: installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 AND git blob == b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, AND every frozen artifact still matches its freeze.json.artifact_hashes entry.
decision_rule.C2_positive_roundtrip: PASS iff AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP passes on 6/6 families: distill_parameterized instantiates one parameterized Mechanism (confidence 0.9 == _parameterized_confidence ceiling, non-empty parameter_slots, non-empty verification_rule.parameter_supports, slots disjoint from the four noise fields), exactly one permutation of slots -> held_out values resolves EXECUTABLE with the correct bound identifier, bound action non-null, fixture execute status == 200, verify == true.
decision_rule.C3_known_negative_sidecar: PASS iff AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP refusal_rate == 1.0 over all 24 negative cases, with every case non-EXECUTABLE, bound_action null, and a non-empty reason; per-category rates (out-of-support empty/space/slash, missing-parameter, out-of-support pair, wrong-intent) all 1.0; AND the sidecar artifact known_negatives.jsonl is written with the per-case rows.
decision_rule.C4_treatment_contrast: PASS iff AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST real contrast_rate > 0.0 on at least one family AND NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT degenerate variant is detected (degenerate contrast_rate == 0.0, degenerate_variant_detected == true).
decision_rule.C5_accounting_fidelity: PASS iff PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY: scripted-trajectory max relative error <= 0.01 AND inherited-path increments == exactly {retrieval_calls: 3, verification_calls: 2, repair_attempts: 1} AND model_calls == 0 AND model_tokens == 0.
decision_rule.C7_promotability_tests: PASS iff after the byte-exact install the pre-existing tests/test_kernel.py passes under the canonical discovery invocation, the EXECUTE-added shipping-path unit tests (tests/test_ship_kernel.py) pass, and `python -m compileall -q src scripts` returns 0. (python scripts/validate_repo.py is additionally exercised by the promotion workflow on main.)

OVERALL_OUTCOME.SUPPORTS: C1 through C7 all PASS. status=COMPLETE; blocker B1/readiness condition (1) is satisfied on the shipped path: the shipped execution path contains a concrete parameterized mechanism visibly instantiated by an inherited procedure and executed, with the companion known-negative refusal sidecar; the packet is promotion-ready and the packet recommends promote_to_product=true (the DIRECTOR verdict decides; PRODUCT_CORE requires Product lane, PASS audit and promotion intent).
OVERALL_OUTCOME.FALSIFIES: C2 fails after a C1-passing byte-exact install, or C7 fails after a C1-passing byte-exact install. status=COMPLETE. The audited carrier, once installed at the shipping position, cannot carry the inherited-parameterized round trip and/or is incompatible with the shipping test/compile surface; it is not promotable in its audited form. Reachability is not vacuous: the DESIGN preinstall probe shows the unmodified shipped kernel fails C2 (no distill_parameterized) and C1 (hash 46929b3a != 718efa6a), and the drift probe shows C1 detects any byte drift.
OVERALL_OUTCOME.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: C1 fails (identity/binding violated or a frozen artifact changed), or C3, C4, C5 or C6 fails (the arm-differentiation instrumentation does not behave as frozen). status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Do not promote; repair the instrumentation and re-run under a new frozen packet. This must never be recorded as a scientific negative; the v1 defect in which a certificate gate was asserted but not enforced must not recur (parent handoff established).
OVERALL_OUTCOME.BLOCKED: Infrastructure/prerequisite failure independent of the hypothesis: src/ not writable within the Product execute scope, the checker cannot run in the environment, or install cannot be performed. status=BLOCKED. Never encode this as FALSIFIES.

product_consequence_positive: The audited parameterized-inheritance carrier is installed byte-identically at src/spider/kernel.py and the arm-differentiation certificate plus unit tests pass on the shipped package, so the EXECUTE packet supports promotion. DIRECTOR may advance C-PARAM-INHERIT to PRODUCT_CORE with promote_to_product=true (finalize_lane.py requires a PASS audit, the Product lane, and promotion intent for that status; SHIPPED is post-promotion and is not a lane-Director status). The pinned Product promotion workflow (product-promote.yml) then applies ONLY the audited src/ + tests/ delta (src/spider/kernel.py plus tests/test_ship_kernel.py) between pre_execute_sha and the verdict-creation commit onto current main, runs compileall/validate_repo/the canonical unit-test discovery, and commits -- no manual copying of experiment code into main. Blocker B1 and readiness condition (1) for the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark are cleared: the shipped kernel no longer emits literals at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold; it contains the parameterized mechanism path (distill_parameterized -> resolve -> verify) with a durable known-negative refusal sidecar. Claim-level consequence: C-PARAM-INHERIT may advance toward PRODUCT_CORE under a PASS audit + promotion; the four-arm economics benchmark remains a SEPARATE future experiment on a provisioned endpoint (parent handoff next_question) and receives ZERO claim-level evidence from this packet.
product_consequence_negative: No promotion. The installed kernel is reverted to the frozen baseline identity B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) via revert_product_reject.py so the Product branch tree carries no residue, and C-PARAM-INHERIT retains its prior effective epistemic status (EXPERIMENTAL). If the outcome is FALSIFIES, the audited carrier is not promotable in its current form and the next action is a bounded integration-defect diagnosis identifying the exact incompatibility (positive round trip at the shipping position, or shipping test/compile surface incompatibility) before any re-port. If the outcome is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, the arm-differentiation instrumentation (not the capability) is at fault and must be repaired and re-run under a new frozen packet.
estimated_cost: Low. Pure determinism with the standard library: no model calls, no browser, no network, no GPU, no cloud. The certificate over 6 families and 24 negative cases plus accounting and regression checks completes in seconds (probe total wall time < 5 s). EXECUTE writes the installed kernel, one new unit-test module, a certificate runner, the fixture reconstruction and raw certificate JSON; well under 60 seconds wall-clock and negligible resource cost.
expected_information_gain: High for the program, bounded and explicitly disclosed for the claim. Program value: this is a fresh v2 landing packet under the Director's explicit mandate (allocate: CONTINUE C-PARAM-INHERIT; parent_handoff disposition SUPERSEDE) -- nothing in accepted evidence has ever shown the audited carrier operating at the shipping position inside the real src/spider tree, and the eight consecutive prior landing-design attempts (EXP-PRODUCT-37999047472, 38040095008, 38047739799, 38051422731, 38072222177, 38085188374, 38087593079, 38094123727) all failed before freeze, so the delivered delta here is a freeze-eligible design whose satisfiability/identifiability is demonstrated pre-freeze (probe sha a7f42ec4..., all checks green, both dynamic-range directions shown). It directly closes readiness condition (1)/blocker B1 -- the highest-leverage open blocker identified by the Global Research Director -- and makes the pinned Product promotion path end-to-end exercisable for the first time. Claim-level information gain is bounded and disclosed: because the installed bytes are pinned to the frozen audited carrier, the certificate is deterministic and was already demonstrated as the pre-freeze satisfiability probe, so this experiment is a durability/integration/promotion confirmation, not a new causal discovery about web behavior; C-PARAM-INHERIT's registered next_gate (learn on resource A, succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines) is only PARTIALLY touched (succeed on never-observed B is exercised on the synthetic fixture; cold/replay/retrieval economics remain untested and require the provisioned-endpoint four-arm benchmark). The residual uncertainty it tests is real and has repeatedly blocked the program: whether the audited capability survives installation at the shipping position and the repository's promotion checks (import surface, identity, regression suite, compileall, validate_repo) without manual intervention, and whether the decision machinery detects failure when the state is NOT installed (preinstall/drift probes).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every decision branch is reachable and no branch is empty. SUPPORTS is reachable: the DESIGN satisfiability probe (prereg.md section 7, probe_exp_38101226651.py sha256 a7f42ec4e87089b10bd18d2e1492e1dd2ca3dc8194ff68608ec665855e2f608e, PROBE_SUMMARY) produced PASS on all eight probes (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP 6/6 with one parameterized mechanism per family, AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP 24/24 with per-kind rates 1.0, AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST real contrast 6/6 unequal families + degenerate detected, PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY scripted max rel err 0.0 + inherited increments exactly {3,2,1}, B-LITERAL-KERNEL 0 EXECUTABLE, AD-IDENTITY-BINDING carrier match + pre/post differ, PKG-TESTS green, COMPILEALL rc 0) with the frozen carrier laid at the shipping position inside a byte-faithful replica of the real tree. FALSIFIES is reachable and was EMPIRICALLY demonstrated pre-freeze: (a) the preinstall probe shows the current shipped kernel has no distill_parameterized and fails C2 on all six families, and fails C1 (46929b3a != 718efa6a) -- the certificate detects the not-installed state rather than vacuously passing; (b) C7 observes, not assumes, the regression suite: any regression or compile failure after a C1-passing install yields FALSIFIES (the EXECUTE-added test module is new, unpinned code). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable: the drift probe demonstrates C1 detects a single-byte drift of the installed kernel (observed 42e3b667... != required 718efa6a...), and the degenerate zero-contrast null is instrumented to FAIL on a no-difference certificate (NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT detected == true only when degenerate rate == 0.0). BLOCKED is reachable on scope/environment/install failure. The certificate runner computes all checks unconditionally; the SUPPORTS condition is a conjunction over C1-C7 with no vacuous term.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites exist and were exercised at DESIGN. Python 3.12.15 and git 2.55.0 present (the probe ran on them). The certificate is standard-library-only and credential-free (no model, browser, network or database), so there is no external substrate prerequisite -- the four-arm economics benchmark's model-endpoint blocker (EXP-INTEL-37973264582) does not apply because this experiment invokes no model. The Product execute scope permits writing src/ and tests/ (research/lanes/registry.json product.allowed_code_roots = [src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml]; check_scope.py execute prefixes include the experiment dir plus those roots). Every freeze artifact exists at freeze time (verified sha256 in prereg.md section 6 and by freeze.json.artifact_hashes at freeze). execution_checkpoint.json (with pre_execute_sha) is written automatically before EXECUTE by scripts/record_execution_base.py. The canonical test invocation, compileall, the certificate and the preinstall/drift probes all ran successfully during DESIGN. The only module that changes, src/spider/kernel.py, is intentionally NOT a freeze artifact because EXECUTE must replace its content; its required post-install identity is pinned to the frozen carrier hash via C1 and its pre-install identity is recorded as B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL (this directly addresses the parent handoff's do_not_assume that freeze.json cannot hash code: the carrier IS hashed; the install target is identity-pinned).

baseline_identifiability.reason: The treatment and every comparator are distinct, observable objects, and the baseline sits at its FLOOR while the treatment sits at a demonstrated ceiling that is still above the floor (dynamic range certified pre-freeze, per mandate agent priors (2)/(3)). B-LITERAL-KERNEL (literal distill at confidence 0.5 vs min_confidence 0.8) yields 0 EXECUTABLE on the parameterized held-out tasks while the treatment yields EXECUTABLE with correctly bound held-out identifiers (probe: 0 vs 6/6). The pre-install shipping kernel is a different git blob (cfec9866...) from the installed carrier (b15ed848...), so the pre/post identity contrast is unambiguous and was measured in both directions (post-install probe vs preinstall probe).
